title: Let Afflicted and Crossed pursue durable, distinct lives
objective: Turn A39's state-specific pressures and first actions into continuing individual and social activity. An Afflicted or Crossed person can recognize a private situation, decide whether to act alone or address particular people, carry a commitment through real movement and material work, revise or abandon it, and live with the result. The two states share only the ZAO driver and SAO native services; their motives, feasible options, appraisal and consequences remain distinct.
context: Crucible interaction skill-8ab3a6c22938008a, item seam-715fed80d31d2f9a, selected zao-life-depth. Current ZAO A39 already supplies one driver, distinct maintenance, actor-private targets, exact food/butchery/contamination actions and first holding evidence. Current SAO C79 supplies acquired proposals, independent responses, scoped commitments and exact SourceUse/Handover/Locomotion work, while C80 exposes the ZAO-owned human shell and C82 observes responses without behavior authority. The remaining source-visible gap is that ZAO policies mostly score immediate individual options: they do not originate durable social matters or carry a state-owned purpose across a wider material sequence. This plan connects those existing owners instead of defining fixed Afflicted or Crossed factions. It also corrects the stale categorical Afflicted-feeding sentence in MUTATION.md to the later DR-031 ruling: possible but individual for Afflicted, and possible but dispreferred as a Crossed food source; exposure remains separate.
target: ZAO is the primary behavior target at 7ffbcbadb31ae3dc4ac619bcf18806121e6e938c. SAO at a4d749b481aaa8a9fdef660f9065c1b549567550 receives only the generic communication, appraisal and native-work service extensions required to execute ZAO-owned choices while preserving standalone SAO. Speakeasy at 1e26f90d94720a68285fd9e96bcef016bbcf6e0a is regression evidence only in this unit; no training, export or activation change is proposed.

actions.action: Generalize C79's acquired-matter path so a registered external execution owner can appraise any actually received proposal from the actor's current private state.
actions.output: A generic pending-appraisal query and admitted proposal-delivery path in Organization/Communication, plus a ZAO appraisal adapter that supplies current activity, retained capability, relationships, interests and constraints without exporting hidden pathogen truth.
actions.check: Only the acquired proposal revision can be answered; generic message delivery, proximity and group membership remain insufficient. Two recipients can form different responses, and missing ZAO evidence defers rather than becoming a healthy default. C82 remains non-authoritative and receives no condition-private input.

actions.action: Add two concrete state-owned matter producers from existing private evidence: Afflicted provisioning from personal or settlement necessity, and Crossed rendezvous/holding from retained knowledge, capability, relationships and an evidenced place or opportunity.
actions.output: Afflicted can seek specific food or water help without assuming what another person will provide; Crossed can address selected known associates about a bounded destination without turning every observed target into a pack order. Each matter records its actual source evidence, addressees, revision and expiry under SAO_Organization.
actions.check: No per-tick duplicate matters, automatic faction, inferred assent or nearest-target template. Afflicted dietary willingness and Crossed predatory pressure stay separate; ordinary needs, current work and relationships can change, revise, defer, contest or withdraw the matter.

actions.action: Carry accepted commitments through the existing physical owners while ZAO remains the sole actor executor.
actions.output: Food/water acquisition, carrying and handover use SourceUse, Locomotion and Handover; accepted rendezvous/holding uses Locomotion and an exact arrival/holding result. Current ZAO activity can pause, interrupt, resume or supersede the work, and state policy independently chooses what follows after delivery or arrival.
actions.check: Queue admission is never completion. Exact item, route and handover receipts are consumed once; missing cargo, changed source, refused route, danger, death and revision produce distinct failure/partial/interrupted outcomes. A Crossed arrival does not manufacture combat, fear, captivity, exposure or settlement.

actions.action: Preserve the purpose, participants, dissent, work and result across loaded/dormant handoff, save/reload and Afflicted-to-Crossed ownership continuity.
actions.output: Organization/GraphPersistence remains the sole durable social-process store; ZAO StateStore retains only state-policy activity and native route/action identity. Reconstruction rebinds runtime adapters and revalidates current body, capability, source and destination before progress.
actions.check: Reload and dormant partitioning cannot duplicate a response, commitment, transfer or arrival. Conversion retains the driver but reappraises the now-Crossed policy; death and ownership exit stop live work without erasing history. Standalone SAO remains readable and executable.

actions.action: Add discriminating production-path controls, synchronize canonical records and publish each repository through its own closed-batch branch/PR/squash-merge process.
actions.output: A new ZAO border covers both state producers and long-horizon execution; an SAO border covers generic acquired appraisal and the new physical commitment family. Mutation controls reverse private acquisition, policy separation, exact-once completion, interruption and persistence invariants. Canonical ZAO prose is reconciled with DR-031.
actions.check: Run focused controls and both complete repository gates, then verify protected-main publication, clean tracked trees and remote parity. Report mechanical/headless evidence separately from unobserved loaded gameplay, animation, balance and long-horizon ecology.

completionEvidence: An Afflicted person's evidenced need can become an addressed request, independent answers and an actual exact-item delivery or honest failure; the recipient's own diet and maintenance policy determines the consequence.

A Crossed person's retained knowledge, capability, relationship and current priorities can produce a revisable rendezvous/holding matter with mixed responses; accepted actors physically arrive or fail, and existing individual policy decides subsequent ordinary, social or predatory action.

Accepted work pauses for state-owned competing activity and later resumes without duplicate receipts; revision, withdrawal, unanswered recipients, save/reload, dormant handoff, conversion and death retain their distinct histories.

Negative controls fail if state policies are merged, hidden state leaks, proximity answers, selection grants completion, an arrival manufactures a downstream outcome, or a terminal receipt is consumed twice.
boundaries: This is the first long-horizon ZAO-life unit, not a claim that either life is complete. Agriculture, construction, capture, use of the dead, wider tools/weapons, variable leisure and broader institutional development retain their own future native producers.

No new Afflicted or Crossed physiology, cognition, body representation, mortality, migration or conversion rule is introduced. DR-030 and DR-031 plus current MUTATION.md establish the state distinctions used here.
The combined SAO+ZAO simulation is central, while standalone SAO must continue to pass. Mousecat and Speakeasy are not code-edit targets for this unit.
No game/app launch, desktop focus/input, active-save mutation or gameplay acceptance occurs. Background mechanical and installed-VM checks are permitted.
stopConditions: A required behavior needs a substantive new ruling about Afflicted or Crossed motives rather than an implementation of the established pressures: return with the exact choice instead of inventing it.
A native action cannot produce a truthful completion/result without bypassing SourceUse, Handover, Locomotion, Organization or the one-body-owner boundary: revise the action slice before proceeding.
Persistence or migration would discard existing identity, process history, pathogen state, possessions or exact result ownership: repair or revise before publication.
examples: An Afflicted person at held ground is hungry and privately knows two people. One is occupied and defers; the other accepts but can only deliver ordinary food. The item is actually acquired and handed over. The Afflicted recipient may use it with the state-specific consequence, qualify the request, or leave it; neither acceptance nor delivery decides the meal in advance.

A Crossed person remembers useful ground and sees two known Crossed associates. The person proposes meeting there. One accepts, one contests because of their relationship and current purpose. Arrival is real movement and can contribute holding evidence, but it does not force a hunt, settlement or common target.

A participant begins carrying an accepted item, interrupts for an observed acute danger, survives a save/reload and resumes. If the proposal was revised or the cargo disappeared, the old work ends with that exact reason instead of silently completing.
